hearts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied 4×4 sixteen-frame heart animation atlas.
Remove the entire fuzzy pink/red glow, clouds, halo, haze and speckled residue around every heart. Outside the three heart silhouettes in each cel, every pixel must be fully transparent. This is the single main correction.
Preserve the sixteen DIFFERENT existing animation poses and the exact 4×4 cell layout. Refine the hearts into clean flat mature cel art using only three solid colors: deep rose #ef3e73, pink #ff91b1, small pale blush #ffe6ef highlights. No gradients, no rounded 3D glossy shading, no thick edge outline, no aura. Keep three hearts with varied sizes per cel. Subtle compression/opening and the rising small hearts must remain a continuous independently drawn loop.
Keep all heart art within each cell's x=18–82%, y=12–84% bounds, with truly empty gutters. No added elements, text, border, grid, watermark or background. True alpha transparency.
hearts.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent PNG sprite atlas for animated decorations attached to karaoke letters.
The provided fire and lightning atlases are STYLE references only: match the clean contemporary cel art, restrained color layering, graphic polish and tiny readable scale. Do not copy their branching shapes or transparent-edge residue.
EXACTLY sixteen independently drawn successive cels in a perfectly regular 4 by 4 grid of square cells, left to right, top to bottom. True transparent alpha background, completely empty gutters, no visible grid or labels. Keep all art inside each cell with at least 10% safe margins. A consistent small overall footprint in every frame. Sixteen real drawings with changes to the silhouette and interior shapes, never one rigid image tilted back and forth. Frame sixteen loops naturally into frame one.
Use only three flat colors with clean curved silhouettes and a few small inner highlight shapes. No realism, airbrush, glow, texture, glossy 3D surfaces, thick outlines, cute faces, emoji shading, glitter, random speckles, badges, floor/platform, backdrop, text, numbers, watermark, or logos. It must remain elegant and readable when drawn beside 32px Thai lyrics.
Subject: a refined cluster of THREE small rose-pink hearts, one medium, one small and one tiny, rising from the lower-center edge of a letter. Vary sizes and phase, not a row of identical icons. Keep a fixed virtual origin at x=50%, y=86%. Artwork stays in x=18–82%, y=12–84%.
Animation: the lower heart compresses and opens with a subtle double heartbeat; other hearts float upward and get smaller before a new heart appears below. Re-draw curved shoulders, pointed bases, highlight shapes and the individual heart positions in every cel. Keep two or three clearly recognizable hearts present at all times; no sudden empty frames, no huge swelling blob. No stems or branching flame shapes.
Palette: deep rose #ef3e73, softer pink #ff91b1, tiny pale blush highlight #ffe6ef. Mature romantic graphic design, not kawaii. No ribbons or background panel.

rain.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent PNG 4×4 sprite atlas with EXACTLY sixteen successive animation cels of fine falling rain.
Input reference: the supplied rain atlas establishes the three-color cel-art style. Refine it into sparse SLIM rainfall streaks rather than large pear-shaped droplet icons.
Four narrow tapered drops per cell, each only 2–3% of cell width and 12–18% of cell height, at x=20%,40%,65%,82%. Tiny asymmetric two-prong splash arcs only at the bottom impact positions near y=84%, with no puddle, floor or underline. Most of the cell is empty transparent space.
Animation physics: each rain path falls from y=12% toward y=82% over the sixteen cels, then breaks into a little splash and a new drop enters at the top. Stagger the four paths by quarter-cycle phases so some drops are always high and some low. Each consecutive cell must have clearly lower drop positions than the prior cell until that path resets after impact. Re-draw streak tips and splash silhouettes, not a static cluster tilting or wobbling. Frame 16 returns naturally to frame 1.
Colors: only three crisp flat colors, deep blue #397caa, cool rain blue #79c5df, tiny pale cyan #dbf5ff. Contemporary polished game cel art, not realistic, not cute, no gloss, no gradients, no glow or airbrush. Clean transparent alpha without colored noise or speckles. Keep 10% clear margins and empty gutters. No cloud, umbrella, scenery, badge, labels, grid, text or watermark.
